# Startup Stash

> The world's largest curated directory of startup tools, resources, and funding opportunities for entrepreneurs and teams.

Startup Stash aggregates thousands of vetted tools and resources across categories like project management, CRM, development, design, and compliance. The platform also features directories of top venture capital firms, startup hubs by country, and industry conferences to support the complete startup lifecycle.

## Core Navigation & Discovery

- [Homepage](https://startupstash.com): Main homepage for Startup Stash, world's largest curated directory of startup tools and resources.
- [Categories](https://startupstash.com/categories): Tool categories index helping users discover startup resources by function and type.
- [Top Tools](https://startupstash.com/top-tools): Curated rankings of top startup tools covering infrastructure, security, automation, and AI agents.
- [Top General](https://startupstash.com/top-general): Top-ranked general startup tools including Terraform, cloud orchestration, and AI infrastructure.
- [Alternative Tools](https://startupstash.com/alternatives): Alternative tool comparisons across real estate, investor, and property management categories.

## Startup Ecosystems & Funding

- [Top VCs](https://startupstash.com/top-vcs): Directory of top venture capital firms across Europe, USA, and Silicon Valley for startup funding.
- [Top Startups by Country](https://startupstash.com/top-startups-by-country): Directory of top startups by country including Kenya, Canada, Toronto, and global startup hubs.
- [Top Conferences](https://startupstash.com/top-conferences): Guide to top tech conferences and industry events for professional development and networking.

## Resource Collections

- [Resources](https://startupstash.com/resources): Curated resource collections covering web design, remote work, cybersecurity, and stock photos.

## Project Management & Collaboration Tools

- [Asana](https://startupstash.com/tools/asana): Asana project management and task collaboration tool for remote and distributed teams.
- [Slack](https://startupstash.com/tools/slack): Slack team communication and collaboration platform for workflow management and productivity.

## CRM & Business Tools

- [HubSpot](https://startupstash.com/tools/hubspot): HubSpot CRM tool review covering email integration, contact management, and lead generation.

## Development & Design Tools

- [GitHub](https://startupstash.com/tools/github): GitHub code sharing and version control platform review for development and DevOps teams.
- [Zeplin](https://startupstash.com/tools/zeplin): Zeplin design collaboration tool for style guides, specs, and developer handoff documentation.

## Compliance & Security Tools

- [iubenda](https://startupstash.com/tools/iubenda): iubenda GDPR compliance tool for generating privacy policies and cookie consent management.

## Optional: Messaging & Communication Platforms

- [Telegram](https://startupstash.com/tools/telegram): Telegram secure messaging app featuring encryption, group chat, and message self-destruction.
- [Snapchat](https://startupstash.com/tools/snapchat): Snapchat privacy-focused messaging platform popular with millennials for secure communications.
